record.question: This was the time when she was in High School
record.explanation: When she was in High School identifies the noun time: the time at which she was in High School. It is a relative clause modifying that noun, called an Adjective Clause in the offered terminology. The presence of when does not by itself make a clause an adverb clause of time. Verified solution (unofficial); reviewed 26 October 2026. References: https://www.ef.co.uk/english-resources/english-grammar/relative-adverbs/
